gaps.reason: The Weyl occurrence is a one-parameter unitary group and is linked to the existing Stone one-parameter-group target; the complex-structure occurrence denotes U(H) as a subgroup and does not need a generic group link.
Projective occurrence is covered by the projective-unitary target; weak-continuity occurrence is covered by the strongly-continuous-unitary representation target. No generic link is needed.
A real sequence is a sequence with codomain qualifier; existing sequence target covers the reusable concept.
Contextual phrase in the Taylor theorem, not a standalone reusable definition.
Increasing is an order property on a sequence; the existing sequence target is sufficient and no dedicated target is warranted.
The phrase is a uniqueness conclusion in Stone’s theorem, not a definition target.
Real-linear is a scalar-field qualifier; the existing linear-map target covers it.
The occurrence is a general rank-one operator. The existing rank-one-projector target is narrower and would misrepresent the Kadison example.
A Borel measure is a measure on the Borel sigma algebra. The existing Borel-sigma-algebra target covers the structural qualifier; no misleading standalone target is added.
The source defines symmetric Fock space, so its first occurrence is a definiendum and must not self-link; other occurrences already link to the symmetric-Fock target.
Editorial relationship label, not a mathematical concept requiring a knowl.
The existing creation-and-annihilation-operators target is the canonical source; the occurrence is its own definition and must not self-link.
Generic transformations are covered compositionally by the symplectic-group/form concepts; no separate transformation target is needed.
Fock–Cook field terminology is defined in the existing Fock–Cook quantization source; no duplicate standalone field target is needed.
Qualifier on the Bolzano–Weierstrass corollary, not a standalone concept.
Generic example class with no canonical target; a diagonal-operator knowl would add little and current examples are self-contained.
Contextual normal-form phrase in a remark, not a reusable definition.
Generic action phrase; existing group/action targets would be too broad for this occurrence.
Canonical target now exists and the Weyl example is linked to it.
